recipe_version.title: Herb-Butter Roast Turkey Breast with Cranberry-Orange Sauce and Roasted Vegetables
recipe_version.description: A boneless turkey breast roast rubbed under and over the skin with garlic, sage, thyme, and rosemary butter, roasted over potatoes, carrots, and red onion until golden and juicy. Served sliced with a quick fresh cranberry-orange sauce.

ingredients.name: boneless skin-on turkey breast roast
ingredients.note: tied, or tie it at 2-inch intervals

steps.title: Preheat and prep
steps.body: Preheat the oven to 375 F. Mash the butter with the garlic, sage, thyme, rosemary, 2 tsp salt, and the pepper. Loosen the turkey skin with your fingers and spread half the butter under it and the rest over the top; tie the roast if needed. Halve the potatoes, cut the carrots, and wedge the onion, then toss with the olive oil and 1 tsp salt. Zest and juice the orange.

steps.title: Arrange
steps.body: Spread the vegetables in a large roasting pan and set the turkey skin side up in the middle.

steps.title: Roast
steps.body: Roast until the thickest part of the turkey reads 160 F and the skin is golden, about 1 hour 15 minutes, stirring the vegetables once halfway.

steps.title: Rest
steps.body: Move the turkey to a board, tent loosely with foil, and rest 15 minutes. Return the vegetables to the oven while it rests if they need more color.

steps.title: Make the cranberry sauce
steps.body: During the roast, simmer the cranberries, sugar, orange juice and zest, and 1/2 cup water in a 2-quart saucepan over medium, stirring, until most berries burst and the sauce thickens, about 12 minutes. Cool to warm (overlap stated).

steps.title: Carve and serve
steps.body: Remove the twine, slice the turkey 1/2 inch thick, and serve with the roasted vegetables and cranberry sauce, spooning the pan juices over the slices.

equipment: large roasting pan or rimmed sheet pan
